== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The data core is a significant physical object containing research conducted by the [[Karoshan|Karoshans]] regarding the [[Iron Legion]]. This information was gathered from various materials left behind by a group of travelers. The core is considered an essential asset, prompting characters to attempt to secure it or prevent it from falling into the hands of [[Solstice]]. Throughout various encounters, the object is transported by different individuals and has been described as being lost or even severed.}}

== The Pilot ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Considered a vital component, the data core was previously believed to be lost. Its contents hold forbidden research regarding the creation of the [[Iron King]] and various nameless abominations from [[Subspace]]. Although its information was copied by a clone of [[Benri Vallenar]], the physical object eventually appeared as a severed unit resting on a laboratory table.}}
